findings.motion: HJR 103, constitutional amendment on attorney general authority to prosecute election-law offenses
findings.note: Listed on her authored-bills report. Proposes a constitutional amendment specifying the attorney general's authority to prosecute a criminal offense under the state's election laws. Referred to State Affairs on 2025-03-12. Related election-integrity item, not an ID rule.
